summary.en: Command-line client for the Gemini API. The v0.4.6 release ships gemini-api_Windows_arm64.zip.
summary.zh-TW: Gemini API 的命令列工具，v0.4.6 版提供 gemini-api_Windows_arm64.zip。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
